Strings.proxy_server.runtime.intro: Managed runtimes install from a signed version catalog. Confirm the source and target version first, then the host runs a bounded transaction. The program version, active revision, and published configuration are recorded separately.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_required: An unfinished recovery is pending. Resolve that operation before installing, updating, or uninstalling.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_intro: The last change did not finish its compensation, so the host rejects further installs, updates, and removals. Resolve it here first: retry the host recovery, stop the service, or close the transaction once it is provably stopped and recovery is hopeless.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_close_warn: Closing only marks the transaction as failed and lifts the block. It restores no configuration, service, or program file. The service must already be stopped. Continue?
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_close_hint: Closing repairs nothing. Run Repair afterwards so the host re-validates the program digest and the published configuration.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_stopped: The service is stopped; the transaction is still open.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_closed: The transaction is closed. Run Repair to re-validate it.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_still_requ: Compensation is still incomplete; the transaction stays in recovery.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.catalog_absent: No version catalog has been obtained yet. Refreshing never starts an installation.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.catalog_loaded: Catalog has {0} releases · valid until {1} · revision {2}
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.catalog_fresh_hint: The catalog may come from cache. An expired or unrefreshable catalog is never reported as up to date.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.refresh_failed: The version catalog could not be refreshed; the last result is still shown.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.action.Rollback: Roll back to the selected version
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.action.Unavailable: No change is allowed in this state
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.action_hint: A frozen plan is requested from the host before anything runs; missing trust, configuration support, or target support only shows the block reason.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.action_tooltip: After the plan is accepted the Helper revalidates the source and artifact digests before switching.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.cancel_hint: Only the download and preparation stages can be cancelled; once the host has passed its switch checkpoint it finishes the change instead.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested; waiting for the host to confirm.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.environment_hint: Measured by the host before an install: platform, service host, free space and the managed directory. No path or command is shown here.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.environment.warning: This host platform is not supported, so a managed install cannot run here.
No fixed service host was detected, so a service cannot be registered or supervised.
The managed directory cannot be used as a private directory (it may be a link elsewhere, or not a directory).
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.dependency.unknown: Whether {0} is satisfied cannot be confirmed, and the host refuses to install without a measurement.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.dependency.disk_spa: Not enough free space: {0} available, {1} required.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.dependency.platform: The platform must be {0}; this host is {1}.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.dependency.service_: The service host must be {0}; none was detected on this host.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.dependency.file_sys: The managed directory cannot be used as a private directory.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.requires_manage: Host management permission is required to install or update a runtime.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.hint: An update restarts the service as needed. Credentials and certificates follow the current published configuration; a rollback never restores revoked credentials.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.include_prerelease_: Prerelease versions are excluded by default and only requested or shown after an explicit opt-in.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.no_sources: No trusted release source is registered. Sources live in protected host configuration; the application cannot create trust.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.no_releases: The current source has no matching release.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.configurati: The native configuration capability of this release is not supported by the current generator.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.release_unt: The artifact source is unconfirmed or revoked.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.target_unsu: The target platform or install mode does not match this host.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.source_untr: The release source is unconfirmed or disabled.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.source_mism: The source and catalog do not match.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.source_not_: That release source was not found.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.catalog_mis: No version catalog has been obtained.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.catalog_exp: The version catalog has expired; refresh it.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.catalog_rep: The catalog revision is below the accepted high-water mark.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.catalog_unv: The catalog signature is not verified.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.catalog_rev: The catalog changed after acceptance; choose again.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.trust_revis: The trust revision changed; refresh the source.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.state_revis: The installation state changed; refresh and retry.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.state_unkno: The host cannot confirm the current state.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.external_in: An external installation exists and cannot be taken over here.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.not_managed: This is not a managed installation.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.recovery_re: An unfinished recovery must be completed first.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.installatio: The installation identity does not match the request.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.release_unk: The target release is missing from the catalog or ambiguous.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.release_ide: The release identity does not match the source.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.channel_not: Prerelease versions are not allowed here.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.artifact_in: The artifact layout or digest metadata is invalid.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.repair_targ: Repair only targets the active release.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.target_unch: The target release is already current.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.update_targ: The target version is not newer than the measured version.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.native_vers: The native program version output is not recognized.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.change_unsu: This change type is not supported yet.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.platform_un: This host platform does not support managed runtime operations.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.helper_resp: The privileged helper returned an unrecognized result.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.operation_p: The operation has not finished yet.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.recovery_ta: The recovery target does not match the pending transaction.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.installed_f: Installed files no longer match the immutable revision.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.configurati: The published configuration differs from the recorded identity.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.direct_relo: The live result of the direct reload is unknown. Retry can restore the previous configuration on disk if the candidate still matches. The recovery record stays open.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.direct_prof: The runtime acknowledged the reload. Retry verifies the candidate configuration and finishes the profile selection without reloading the runtime.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.direct_sett: The runtime and host acknowledged the update. Retry verifies and saves the local settings without repeating either operation.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.direct_trac: The original host proxy change still needs verification. Recovery uses its original receipt.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.direct_comp: The separate restoration operation is still awaiting verification.
The saved policy or TUN safety state prevents this restoration.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.direct_sett: The original change was interrupted and the saved policy was restored.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.recovery_compensate: Restore the saved Mihomo listener and host proxy policy using a separate recovery operation?
Saved proxy policy restored. Recovery ID {0}.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.settings_dr: The saved proxy settings changed independently. The recovery record remains open.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.staging_con: The staging area conflicts with this operation.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.uninstall_scope: Uninstalling stops and removes the service registration and program files this host owns. The published configuration and credentials are kept by default and remain usable after a reinstall. Deleting data also removes the configuration and its retained copy; that cannot be undone. Certificates and private keys belong to the server-center certificate store and the runtime root only holds the published configuration, so removal never deletes them. This runtime creates no firewall rules of its own.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.uninstall_warning: The service stops and program files are deleted. Configuration and credentials are kept for a later reinstall. Continue?
Strings.proxy_server.runtime.uninstall_delete_wa: The service stops, and program files, the published configuration, and its retained copy are deleted permanently. Continue?
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.removal_fai: The runtime could not be removed; the previous service was restored.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.removal_inc: The service registration still exists; removal did not complete.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.removal_cle: The service was removed, but cleaning up programs or data failed.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.compensatio: The restored service failed verification and needs manual attention.
Compensation did not finish; the installation is in a recovery-required state.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.idempotency: The idempotency key was already used for a different request.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.action_unsu: This change type is not supported.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.rollback_un: That release is not a revision kept on this host and cannot be restored.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.health_chec: The post-switch health check did not pass.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.snapshot_in: The captured service snapshot is not valid.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.prepared_id: The prepared revision identity does not match the plan.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.transaction: The transaction state reached its size limit.
The transaction state file is not valid.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.dependencie: The host does not meet the prerequisites, so nothing was submitted.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.recovery_no: That transaction has not failed its compensation, so it cannot be closed.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.recovery_st: The service must be stopped first.
The service could not be stopped.
The previous stop is unconfirmed. The service is still running and recovery will not send another stop command.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.service_obs: The service state could not be observed.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.recovery_cl: The transaction was closed by an operator and has not been re-validated.
Strings.proxy_server.runtime_problem.elevation_c: Elevation was cancelled; nothing was executed.
